<thought>To construct 4,4'-dimethoxystilbene in a single step, a Wittig reaction is ideal: 4‑methoxybenzaldehyde reacts with the phosphonium ylide derived from 4‑methoxybenzyl bromide (or its phosphonium salt). Both 4‑methoxybenzaldehyde and 4‑methoxybenzyl bromide are inexpensive, commercially available, and together cost well under $150. I located a retrosynthetic template that converts an aldehyde and a phosphonium bromide into a substituted alkene (Wittig). This template will be used for the single‑step synthesis.</thought>

  "smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
